one_line_thesis: U.S. OTC market infrastructure and ATS operator — a Stahl croupier with subscription-heavy fees and expanding disclosure tiers (OTCID) and extended-hours trading — earnings scale with issuer count and activity, not balance-sheet risk.

deep_dive.executive_summary: OTC Markets is U.S. OTC listing and ATS infrastructure: subscription-heavy fees on disclosure tiers (including new OTCID tier) and extended-hours trading. Full-tier FY2025 and Q1 2026 filings confirm acceleration: net revenues +12% FY25 and +15% in Q1, with transaction revenue +38% on higher OTC Link activity. FY2025 mix was 81% subscription / 19% transaction; Q1 2026 shifted to 78% / 22% as volume picked up. OTCID contributed positive revenue in Q1. method_fit.rule: Use one primary method and no more than two corroborating methods; irrelevant methods and personas remain silent.
